landing.why_title: Free online video editor for TikTok, Reels and Instagram
landing.why_text:
2minclip is a free online video editor designed for anyone who needs to edit a video quickly without any complications. You can cut videos online, merge multiple clips into one, add background music and export to MP4 — all from your browser with nothing to install.

It's perfect for creating content for TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts. Choose your format before you start — 9:16 for vertical videos, 16:9 for YouTube or 1:1 for the Instagram feed — and edit directly on that canvas with no surprises at export time.

Unlike other online video editors, 2minclip doesn't ask you to sign up, doesn't add a watermark and has no export limit. It's completely free.

You can use it to trim videos online, change the speed of a clip (slow motion or fast forward), add text with different fonts and colors, overlay images or videos on top, and control the volume of each audio track separately.

All processing happens on your own device — your videos are never uploaded to any server. It works on mobile and desktop, from any modern browser, with no app to download.

If you're looking for a simple online video editor to merge clips, add music and export fast, 2minclip is the simplest tool you'll find.
landing.faq_title: Frequently asked questions about the free online video editor
landing.faq_1_a: Yes, completely free. No watermark, no subscription, no export limit.
landing.faq_2_q: Do I need to create an account?
landing.faq_2_a: No. You go straight in and start editing. No sign-up, no email, no password.
landing.faq_3_q: What format does it export to?
landing.faq_3_a: Always MP4 H.264. The universal format compatible with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and WhatsApp.
landing.faq_4_a: Yes. From any mobile or desktop browser. No app to install.
landing.faq_5_q: What video formats does it accept?
landing.faq_5_a: MP4, MOV and WebM. For audio: MP3, AAC and WAV.
landing.faq_6_q: Is it safe to upload my videos?
landing.faq_6_a: Your videos never leave your device. All processing happens in your own browser using FFmpeg.wasm. Nothing is uploaded to any server.
landing.faq_7_q: How can I merge two videos online for free?
landing.faq_7_a: Upload both videos on the 2minclip landing page, choose your format (9:16, 16:9 or 1:1) and click "Start editing". In the editor you'll see the clips in the timeline — you can reorder them by dragging. When you're ready, click "Export" and download the merged video as MP4. No sign-up, no watermark, free.
landing.faq_8_q: How do I cut a video without downloading any app?
landing.faq_8_a: Go to 2minclip.com from any browser, upload your video and click "Start editing". In the editor, move the playhead to the point where you want to cut and press the "Split" button. Delete the part you don't want and export. All from the browser, nothing to install.
landing.faq_9_q: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
landing.faq_9_a: Yes. 2minclip works from the browser on any mobile device — Chrome on Android and Safari or Chrome on iPhone. No app download required.
landing.faq_10_q: Can I add music to a video online for free?
landing.faq_10_a: Yes. In the editor there is an audio section where you can upload your own music in MP3, AAC or WAV. You can adjust the volume, trim it and add a fade out at the end.
landing.faq_11_q: How long does it take to export the video?
landing.faq_11_a: It depends on the length and the power of your device. For short clips under 60 seconds it usually takes between 10 and 30 seconds. All processing happens on your device, not on an external server.

tutorial.title: How to use 2minclip
tutorial.s1_body: A video editor right in your browser. No install, no account. Everything is processed on your own device.
tutorial.s2_body: Tap '+ Clip' to add MP4, MOV or WebM files. Add music with '+ Audio' and images or overlays with '+ Layer'.
tutorial.s3_body: Use Zoom + / Zoom − or the pinch gesture to adjust the scale. Tap the timeline to move the playhead.
tutorial.s4_body: Tap a clip to select it. Use 'Split' to cut it at the playhead. Drag to reorder. The bottom panel lets you change speed, volume and more.
tutorial.s5_body: Add background music with '+ Audio'. Overlay text with '+ Text' or images with '+ Layer'. Adjust position, duration and opacity in the bottom panel.
tutorial.s6_body: Tap 'Export' when ready. The video is processed on your device and downloaded as MP4. No watermark, no sign-up.
